# Sorrel agent teams

Durable definitions for two **read-only** agent teams (see
[agent-teams docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams)). Agent teams are
experimental and are enabled via `CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1` in
[`.claude/settings.json`](../settings.json) (already set). Requires Claude Code ≥ 2.1.32.

## How these are stored (read this first)

The **runtime** `~/.claude/teams/{team}/config.json` and `~/.claude/tasks/{team}/` are
**auto-generated by Claude Code when a team is launched and deleted when the session ends** —
they hold session/pane IDs and must not be hand-authored (your edits get overwritten). So the
durable definitions live in the repo instead:

- **Member roles** → `.claude/agents/*.md` — reusable subagent definitions, usable both as team
  teammates and as standalone subagents.
- **Per team** → `.claude/agent-teams/{team}/launch.md` (the paste-to-lead spawn prompt) +
  `tasks.md` (the seed task list the lead turns into the shared task list).

## Launching a team

Open a Claude Code session in this repo and **paste the team's `launch.md` spawn prompt** (or
just say "create the {team} agent team"). The lead spawns the members by subagent type and seeds
the shared task list from `tasks.md`. When finished: **"clean up the team"** (always via the lead).

All members are **read-only** (`Read, Glob, Grep, Bash`) — they audit and report, never modify code.

## The teams

| Team               | Folder                                       | Members                                                                                   | Purpose                                                                                                             |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Principal review   | [`principal-review/`](principal-review/)     | architect · staff-frontend · senior-designer · **conversion-analyst** · _qa-engineer_     | Senior whole-project review — architecture, React/Next, pixel-perfection, conversion instrumentation, test strategy |
| Delivery readiness | [`delivery-readiness/`](delivery-readiness/) | devops-release · security · dependency-auditor · **telemetry-conversion** · _qa-engineer_ | Pre-release gap hunt — DevOps, security, dependency versions, telemetry, release QA                                 |

Each team is **5 members**: **bold** = the product/telemetry/conversion lens; _italic_ = the QA/test-engineering lens.

## Review priorities baked in

The teams are tuned to the highest-leverage quality bars for this repo:

- **Pixel fidelity + performance** — exact visual rendering and performance down to paint/layout, not just a green Lighthouse score.
- **Conversion + theming rigour** — the 39→65 conversion thesis (measurement that holds up) plus the two-token-theme design-system discipline and drift prevention.
- **Verification + extensibility** — coverage is expected, and the clearest ownership signal is whether the maintainer can extend a module and explain the change.
